public_authorities.name: Pune Municipal Corporation
public_authorities.pio_designation: Public Information Officer, Pune Municipal Corporation
public_authorities.pio_contact_note: Named PIO not sourced (PMC RTI page JS-rendered — store designation level per §12 data model). Phone: 1800-1030-222. Address: Near Mangala Theatre, Shivajinagar, Pune-411005.
public_authorities.notes: Municipal corporation constituted under Maharashtra Municipal Corporations Act. Subject: municipal services in City of Pune. CLEAN SINGLE-JURISDICTION — primary demo topic 1. Confidence: HIGH for government_level and jurisdiction; MEDIUM for named PIO (not sourced).

public_authorities.name: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Ltd.
public_authorities.pio_contact_note: PIOs designated at Head Office and zone/circle level. List available at mahadiscom.in under RTI section. File to the PIO of the zone handling your area.
public_authorities.notes: Wholly Maharashtra-Government-owned PSU. Subject: electricity distribution, billing, connections for Maharashtra (excluding Mumbai city area). CLEAN SINGLE-JURISDICTION — primary demo topic 2. Confidence: HIGH.

public_authorities.name: Ministry of External Affairs — Regional Passport Office
public_authorities.pio_designation: Public Information Officer, Regional Passport Office [City]
public_authorities.pio_contact_note: File RTI at rtionline.gov.in — select Ministry of External Affairs. For offline: to PIO at the concerned Regional Passport Office.
public_authorities.notes: Passports are a Union List subject (Schedule VII, List I). MEA is a Central Government ministry. File on the CENTRAL portal (rtionline.gov.in), NOT on any state portal. CLEAN SINGLE-JURISDICTION CENTRAL — primary demo topic 3. Confidence: HIGH.

public_authorities.name: Ministry of Education (Government of India)
public_authorities.pio_designation: Public Information Officer, Ministry of Education
public_authorities.pio_contact_note: File at rtionline.gov.in — select Ministry of Education. For centrally-sponsored schemes (PM POSHAN, Samagra Shiksha, etc.) and UGC/NCERT matters.
public_authorities.notes: Education is Concurrent List Entry 25 (Seventh Schedule). Central MoE handles national policy, centrally-sponsored schemes, UGC, NCERT. CONCURRENT LIST — used as the honesty beat in the demo (topic 4). Show ALONGSIDE the State Education Dept entry, never as a sole answer.

public_authorities.name: School Education and Sports Department, Government of Maharashtra
public_authorities.pio_designation: Public Information Officer, School Education and Sports Department, Maharashtra
public_authorities.pio_contact_note: File at rtionline.maharashtra.gov.in — select School Education and Sports Department. For state-administered school matters.
public_authorities.notes: Education is Concurrent List Entry 25. State Education Dept handles day-to-day school administration, state board, state-level schemes. CONCURRENT LIST — shown ALONGSIDE Central MoE for general education queries. Confidence: HIGH for government_level; shown only in 'it depends' dual result.

public_authorities.name: Maharashtra Police (Commissioner of Police / Superintendent of Police)
public_authorities.pio_designation: Public Information Officer, Commissioner of Police [City] / Superintendent of Police [District]
public_authorities.pio_contact_note: File at rtionline.maharashtra.gov.in — search for the relevant police commissionerate or superintendence. For district areas: Superintendent of Police [District name].
public_authorities.notes: Police is a State List subject (Schedule VII, List II, Entry 2). Maharashtra Police is a STATE authority. CLEAN SINGLE-JURISDICTION — backup topic B1. Avoid Delhi queries in demo (Delhi police is CENTRAL/UT). Confidence: HIGH.

public_authorities.name: Department of Pension & Pensioners' Welfare, Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions
public_authorities.pio_designation: Public Information Officer, Department of Pension & Pensioners' Welfare
public_authorities.pio_contact_note: File at rtionline.gov.in — select Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions / Department of Pension & Pensioners' Welfare. For Central Government employee pension matters.
public_authorities.notes: Central Government employee pensions are administered by DoPPW, a Central Government department. CLEAN SINGLE-JURISDICTION CENTRAL — backup topic B2. Note: State government employee pensions are a STATE subject; this authority is specifically for Central Govt employees. Confidence: HIGH.

public_authorities.name: Municipal Corporation of Delhi
public_authorities.pio_designation: Public Information Officer, Municipal Corporation of Delhi [Concerned Zone]
public_authorities.pio_contact_note: MCD has 12 administrative zones. File online at rtionline.delhi.gov.in (select Municipal Corporation of Delhi) or submit in person at the concerned Zonal Citizen Service Bureau.
public_authorities.notes: Unified municipal corporation for National Capital Territory of Delhi. Handles civic roads, drainage, property tax, and sanitation across Delhi.
